name: Swipe card
summary: A card the participant throws left or right to answer: the frosted deck surface, a distance or flick threshold with spring-back, and arrow keys for the keyboard.
highlights: Distance or flick commits; spring-back below
Arrow keys answer without a pointer
Frosted surface that reads on any deck
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-swipe-card> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: radius 12, padding 16, frosted surface, 1px ink hairline, 0 2px 12px shadow in the ink at 18%

spec.label: Gesture
spec.value: commits past 72px or on a flick; tilt capped at 8 degrees; blur dropped while moving; a second finger cancels

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: (slot)
props.desc: The card's content: a statement, a photo, a pair

props.name: static
props.desc: Turns the gesture off (a card in a swipe deck that must not move)

props.name: flat
props.desc: Drops the cast shadow, keeps the edge

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: Names the card when its content is not text

props.name: swipe
props.desc: "left" or "right", from a throw or an arrow key

whenToUse.when: one thing at a time, thrown to answer (this-or-that, would-you-rather, sorting)
a static panel: a swipe card is not a generic box

opinion.note: Never wrap the whole audience screen in a card: the screen is transparent over the deck. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, for a build-less slide page.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
